meta.title: Chalet with Private Chef, Méribel · Full Board — Chalet Yolo
meta.description: Half board or full board with private chef, butler and chauffeur: an ultra-luxury catered chalet in Les 3 Vallées, with service tailored to your stay.

offer.title: The Service & The House
services: Private shuttle included morning and evening to the ski lifts
Daily cleaning of living areas (7 days a week)
Beds made up, linen, bathrobes and slippers

majordome.name: Lina Gerard
majordome.text: Passionate about hospitality, Lina has worked in palace hotels, including Les Airelles and Hôtel Barrière Les Neiges in Courchevel. She brings versatility, discretion and an eye for detail to every stay.

chef.name: Ricardo Tort Albelda
chef.text: Over 25 years in the kitchen, including time at the palace hotels Les Airelles and Hôtel Barrière Les Neiges in Courchevel, and an undiminished passion for fine food, travel and discovering new flavours.
